script:
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events/$E2" --expect 200 --check id eq "$E2"
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events" --json "[\"$E2\"]" --expect 200 \
  --check . len-eq 1 --check 0.id eq "$E2"
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000e6" --expect 404 \
  --save F06.unknown-event/get-one  # bug
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events" --json "[\"$E2\", \"qa-missing-event\"]" --expect 200 \
  --check . len-eq 2 --check 0.id eq "$E2" --check 1 missing --save F06.unknown-event/batch  # bug
